# TCPStreamIP <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
TCPStreamIP:Int32 tcp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tcp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The address on the other end of a TCP stream, as a number for [DottedIP](DottedIP).

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* A peer that uses IPv6 has no address as a number, so this returns 0 for it; use [GetTCPStreamAddress](GetTCPStreamAddress). IPv4 peers are not changed.
